help.title: Help
help.empty.heading: Help and support
help.empty.body: Setup guides, answers to common questions and a way to contact us.
help.setup.heading: Setup guide
help.setup.intro: Six steps take most stores about 15 minutes. Home shows which steps are done.
help.setup.tier.title: Create a tier.
help.setup.tier.body: A tier is a wholesale price level, such as 20% off. Tradepass creates the B2B market and catalog in Shopify for you.
help.setup.form.title: Review your form.
help.setup.form.body: Choose which questions businesses answer, and change any wording or translation.
help.setup.embed.title: Turn on the app embed.
help.setup.embed.body: In your theme editor, open App embeds, switch on Tradepass and save. Tradepass never edits your theme files.
help.setup.page.title: Add the form to a page.
help.setup.page.body: See "Add the application form to your store" below.
help.setup.storefront.title: Choose what retail visitors see.
help.setup.storefront.body: Show prices to everyone, hide prices until sign-in, or make the store wholesale-only.
help.setup.test.title: Send a test application.
help.setup.test.body: Fill in the form on your store, then approve it under Applications.
help.addForm.heading: Add the application form to your store
help.addForm.step1: In Shopify, go to Online Store → Pages and create a page, for example "Wholesale". Save it.
help.addForm.step2: Go to Online Store → Themes → Customize, open the new page, then choose Add block → Apps → Wholesale application form.
help.addForm.step3: Save. Open the page on your store to check that the form shows, then send a test application.

help.b2b.heading: How B2B works on your Shopify plan
help.b2b.markets: Since April 2026, Shopify's B2B features are included on the Basic, Grow and Advanced plans as well as Plus. Wholesale buyers are Shopify companies, and their prices come from catalogs.
help.b2b.catalogs: On Basic, Grow and Advanced, catalogs are attached to B2B markets, and a store can have up to 3 B2B catalogs in total, including any you made yourself. Each Tradepass tier uses one B2B market and one catalog, so you can have up to 3 tiers. When you approve a buyer, Tradepass puts their company location into the right market.
help.b2b.plus: On Shopify Plus, catalogs are assigned to company locations directly, and the 3-catalog limit doesn't apply.
help.b2b.signIn: Buyers sign in through customer accounts with a one-time code sent to their email. They see wholesale prices once signed in.
help.faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
help.faq.plus.a: No. Tradepass works on Basic, Grow, Advanced and Plus. Home shows whether B2B is available on your current plan.
help.faq.threeTiers.q: Why can I only have 3 tiers?
help.faq.threeTiers.a: On plans below Plus, Shopify allows 3 B2B catalogs per store, and each tier needs one. Catalogs you made outside Tradepass count too. Plus stores don't have this limit.
help.faq.signIn.a: With Shopify customer accounts: they enter their email and get a one-time code. After approval they get an email explaining this.
help.faq.documents.a: In your own Shopify Files (Content → Files). Tradepass keeps only a reference to each file.
help.faq.hidePrices.a: Yes. Under Storefront, choose to hide prices until a wholesale buyer signs in, or make the whole store wholesale-only.
help.faq.theme.q: Does it work with my theme?
help.faq.theme.a: Tradepass works with Online Store 2.0 themes through an app embed and an app block, without changing theme code. If prices don't hide on a custom theme, use Storefront → Advanced to tell Tradepass where your theme shows prices, or contact us.
help.faq.uninstall.a: Companies, customers, markets and catalogs stay in Shopify because they're yours. Price hiding and the wholesale-only checkout stop right away. Tradepass deletes its own data 48 hours later; reinstall before then to keep it.
help.faq.pos.q: Does it work with Shopify POS?
help.faq.pos.a: Buyers and tiers are standard Shopify B2B, so they work wherever Shopify supports B2B. The wholesale-only checkout lock doesn't apply to POS sales.
help.faq.taxExemptions.a: When you approve, you can save the buyer's tax number and pick tax exemptions (for example a US state resale exemption or EU reverse charge) on their company location. Shopify then applies them at checkout.
help.faq.vatFails.q: What if a VAT number check fails?
help.faq.vatFails.a: The application shows "Tax number not found" or "Couldn't check". Nothing is blocked: you decide whether to approve, ask for more information or reject.
help.faq.import.q: Can I import my existing wholesale customers?
help.faq.import.a: Yes, on the Pro plan. Upload a CSV file, or convert customers that already have a tag such as "wholesale".
help.faq.languages.a: 36 languages. The form, storefront messages and the messages you send applicants appear in each person's language, and you can change any text under Settings → Languages.
help.faq.approvalLimit.q: What happens when I reach 10 approvals on the free plan?
help.faq.approvalLimit.a: New applications are still collected, so you never lose a lead. To approve more that month, choose a paid plan.
help.faq.markets.q: Home says B2B markets aren't turned on. What do I do?
help.faq.markets.a: On plans below Plus, tier prices need Shopify's newer Markets. Turn them on in Shopify under Settings → Markets, then click "Check again" on Home.
help.faq.privacy.a: Tax numbers are encrypted, secure links expire and work once, and rejected applications are deleted after the period you choose in Settings.
help.faq.slowFirstLoad.q: Why is the app sometimes slow to open?
help.faq.slowFirstLoad.a: After a quiet period the app can take up to a minute to wake up. Your storefront is never affected: price hiding and the form keep working.
help.diagnostics.heading: Diagnostic info
help.diagnostics.body: If you contact us, paste this into your email. It contains no customer data.
help.diagnostics.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
help.debug.heading: Storefront debug mode
help.debug.body: Shows outlines and notes on your storefront where Tradepass hides prices or buttons, so you can see what's matched. It turns itself off after {hours} hours.
help.contact.heading: Contact support
help.contact.body: We usually answer within 2 business days.
help.contact.priority: You're on Pro, so your emails are answered first, usually within 1 business day.
help.faq.alerts.q: How do I hear about new applications?
help.faq.alerts.a: Tradepass doesn't send emails. New applications and replies wait for you on Home and under Applications. For an email alert, create a workflow in Shopify Flow (Tradepass Pro) with the trigger “Wholesale application submitted” and Flow's “Send internal email” action. That action only sends to fixed staff addresses you enter in the workflow.
help.faq.applicantStatus.a: Yes. Every message you copy includes a link to their status page. Signed-in customers who applied see their status in the form block instead of the form, and in their customer account if you add the “Wholesale application status” block there (Settings → Customer accounts in Shopify).
help.faq.applicantStatus.q: Can applicants see where their application stands?
help.faq.flowAlerts.a: Tradepass sends no email itself. Use Shopify Flow (free on every plan): pick a Tradepass trigger such as “Wholesale application submitted”, “Wholesale application info received” or “Certificate expiring”, and add “Send internal email” or a Slack message. Each trigger includes the company, contact, email, phone, country, state, tier and a link to the application. “Send internal email” only sends to the fixed staff addresses you type in, so it can't email the applicant.
help.faq.flowAlerts.q: How do I get alerts for new applications?
help.faq.messageApplicants.a: After you ask for more information, reject or approve, Tradepass shows a ready-made message in the applicant's language. Copy it, or open it in your mail app, Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, your phone's text messages, Telegram or LINE. Nothing is sent by Tradepass, so there are no costs or limits. Shopify Messaging automations only reach customers who subscribed to marketing, so they don't suit applicants.
help.faq.messageApplicants.q: How do I write to an applicant?
help.faq.oldTaxExempt.a: Older approvals switched on Shopify's “exempt from all taxes” setting together with the state exemption. Tradepass now applies only the state exemption unless you choose otherwise. Tradepass never changes tax settings on its own: open the company location in Shopify admin and check its tax settings.
help.faq.oldTaxExempt.q: My buyers approved before November 2026 show “Exempt” for all taxes. Why?
help.faq.statePermits.a: For states with a free official lookup, the application shows “Check on the state's website” and what to enter there; mark it as checked so your team sees who checked and when. Texas publishes its active permits as open data, so on Starter and Pro Tradepass checks Texas numbers automatically. There's no free public check for EINs.
help.faq.statePermits.q: Can Tradepass check a seller's permit?
help.faq.usCertificates.a: Applicants choose their certificate (the state's own, the Streamlined Sales Tax certificate, the MTC uniform certificate or a tax-exempt organization's certificate) and add a seller's permit number for each state it covers. Each state becomes its own certificate, with its own expiry. Approval suggests the reseller exemption for the location's state; other covered states are offered but not applied, because Shopify taxes by the ship-to address. States without a statewide sales tax need none.
